name: DOF: Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Queens – FY 2011/2012
description: This dataset contains New York City Department of Finance records used in the FY 2011/2012 property valuation cycle for condominium properties in Queens. Each row represents a condominium and pairs it with up to three comparable rental buildings used as benchmarks for valuation. For each condo, the data includes location identifiers such as borough, block and lot, address, coordinates, community board, council district, census tract, and neighborhood, along with physical characteristics including building classification, total units, year built, and gross square footage. Financial fields cover estimated gross income, estimated expenses, net operating income, full market value, and per-square-foot income, expense, and value figures. Each comparable rental record carries the same physical and financial measures plus its distance in miles from the condo, allowing direct side-by-side comparison. The dataset is useful for analyzing property valuation methods, comparing condo and rental market metrics, studying neighborhood-level housing patterns, and supporting research or modeling of real estate income and market values in Queens
